name: Toril y Masegoso (Spain)
description: Blue field with a band of yellow and red bars from the lower hoist to the upper fly, charged with a yellow bull's head at the upper hoist and a yellow tree at the lower fly.
history: Municipal flag of Toril y Masegoso; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: band of yellow and red bars from the lower hoist to the upper fly
bull's head at the upper hoist
